nodes.label: ExceptionHandlingMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Maps exception types to HTTP status codes (InvalidOperationException->400, UnauthorizedAccessException->401, else 500) and always serializes the stack trace into the response body, which leaks internals outside development.

nodes.label: Centralized Exception-to-HTTP Mapping
nodes.rationale: One middleware converts unhandled exceptions to a uniform JSON error envelope so handlers can throw instead of returning result objects.
